attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as an authoritative Kea DHCP server on eth1 (10.50.50.0/24, the private network shared with node2/node3, static IP 10.50.50.254), serving pool 10.50.50.100-200 with default-router/name-server options. node2 and node3's second NIC (enp8s0, NetworkManager "Wired connection 2") was already set to ipv4.method=auto with no static address, so once node1's DHCP server came up, node2 and node3 obtained dynamic leases (10.50.50.101 and 10.50.50.100 respectively) from node1 rather than any static assignment. Verified end-to-end connectivity on the private network and lease persistence across a full reboot cycle of all three nodes.
